name: finem
description: Finem engineering: one coordinator plus 10 engineering disciplines sharing 180 original skills from 50 pinned Git sources.

plugins.name: finem-core
plugins.description: The single engineering coordinator and shared original skill library for product, architecture, UI/UX, implementation, infrastructure, security and operations.

plugins.name: finem-product-planning
plugins.description: Turn a product problem into a feasible, prioritized plan and measure whether the outcome creates value.

plugins.name: finem-architecture
plugins.description: Define system boundaries, domain rules and clear interfaces so implementation can evolve without spreading coupling.

plugins.name: finem-ui-ux
plugins.description: Design useful, accessible interfaces with coherent visual language, interaction states and motion.

plugins.name: finem-frontend-mobile
plugins.description: Implement the interface in the project's actual web or mobile framework, connecting state, navigation and API boundaries.

plugins.name: finem-backend-data
plugins.description: Build services, persistence and background processing around explicit business rules and data contracts.

plugins.name: finem-infrastructure-devops
plugins.description: Provision reproducible environments and operate the build, release, deployment and rollback path with visible infrastructure costs.

plugins.name: finem-security-privacy
plugins.description: Protect identity, permissions, secrets and personal data, and assess concrete security risks in the implementation.

plugins.name: finem-testing-quality
plugins.description: Verify behavior, integrations and performance and review whether the change is correct and maintainable.

plugins.name: finem-observability-reliability
plugins.description: Make system health measurable, design for failure and support incident diagnosis and recovery.

plugins.name: finem-maintenance-documentation
plugins.description: Keep the system understandable and support safe dependency changes, deprecation and eventual retirement.
